{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm the response column is 'responded'
print("Response column is:", 'responded')

# Check the distribution of 'responded' in the TREATMENT arm
response_in_treatment = trial_df[trial_df['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].value_counts()
print("Response distribution in TREATMENT arm:\n", response_in_treatment)

# Compute the fraction of responders in the TREATMENT arm
num_responders = trial_df[(trial_df['arm'] == 'treatment') & (trial_df['responded'] == 1)].shape[0]
total_treatment = trial_df[trial_df['arm'] == 'treatment'].shape[0]
fraction_responders = num_responders / total_treatment
print(f"Fraction of responders in TREATMENT arm: {fraction_responders}")"}
